creations.name: Natuna-Ranai to Mida
creations.description:
Airline : 
-Garuda Indonesia

NATUNA-RANAI INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT
Located at the edge of Indonesian Territory, Natuna-Ranai Airport served Tourist and Cargoes off and into the Great Natuna Island, Riau Islands. Above are planes flying to/from Australia and Singapore, strategic for emergency landing of Wide Body Aircraft. Small Terminal, just enough to support 50 passengers.

MIDA AIRSTRIP
Very small, short grass runway at the island of Mida. To serve tourist as tourist attractions on this island are great. Doesn't operate at night or when raining.
